A traffic incident.

public TrafficIncident(string Id, string Description, TrafficIncidentType Type, TrafficIncidentImpact Impact, GeoPolyline? Geometry = null, GeoCoordinates? Location = null, long? StartTime = null, long? EndTime = null, bool? RoadClosed = null)

Parameters

Id string

Stable identifier of the incident from the HERE traffic feed.

Description string

Human-readable description (typically a localized road name + cause).

Type TrafficIncidentType

High-level category (accident, congestion, …).

Impact TrafficIncidentImpact

Severity of the delay (minor, major, closed, …).

Geometry GeoPolyline

Optional road polyline covered by the incident.

Location GeoCoordinates

First coordinate of the incident's polyline (the point on the road where the incident starts). Used by the RefApp to drop a marker on the map. On iOS this is read from TrafficIncident.location.polyline.vertices.first; on Android from TrafficIncident.getLocation().getPolyline().getVertices().get(0).

StartTime long?

Optional start time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

EndTime long?

Optional end time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

RoadClosed bool?

True if the incident reports the road as fully closed.
